headline_marked: Body of former air force officer [[Tahsif Souri]] recovered from Turag river
headline: Body of former air force officer Tahsif Souri recovered from Turag river
summary: The body of former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri was recovered from the Turag river after floating downstream and getting stuck near Rajabari ghat. Police are investigating the death.
details: A body floating in the Turag river was discovered near Rajabari ghat in Uttarkhan and later identified as former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri. The body had been lodged against a speedboat for several hours before police recovered it.

The discovery was made around 2:00 PM yesterday by Khokon Mia, who is in charge of the ghat. He reported seeing the body float downstream and get stuck against a moored speedboat. Police were alerted and arrived at the scene around 4:30 PM.

Tahsif Souri had recently gained attention in connection with a video purportedly showing ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina leaving the country by aircraft on August 5, 2024. Reports suggest he may have been the person who recorded the footage.

The deceased was estimated to be around 28 years old and was found wearing a white pyjama and a black shirt, with a wristwatch on his hand and an iPhone in his pocket. The body was identified using the phone found with him.

The body has been sent to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College morgue for legal procedures and an autopsy. The Home Minister stated that details regarding Tahsif's death would be available after the investigation and autopsy are complete.

headline_marked: AL leader [[Hanif sentenced to death]] for crimes against humanity in Kushtia
headline: AL leader Hanif sentenced to death for crimes against humanity in Kushtia
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 sentenced Mahbubul Alam Hanif to death and three other party leaders to life imprisonment for the killing of six protesters.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has sentenced Awami League Joint General Secretary Mahbubul Alam Hanif to death for the killing of six people in Kushtia during the July Uprising.

Three other party leaders—Kushtia district AL President Sadruddin Khan, district AL General Secretary Azgar Ali, and city AL General Secretary Ataur Rahman Ata—were sentenced to imprisonment until death.
The tribunal ordered the confiscation of half of the immovable property of all four convicted leaders to be distributed as compensation to the victims and their families.
The prosecution argued that Hanif endorsed provocative statements and incited violence against protesters, describing them as criminals and communal elements.
The prosecution further stated that Hanif's statements encouraged the use of lethal weapons, contributing to over 1,400 deaths and 25,000 injuries nationwide.
In Kushtia, the accused were found to have directed local leaders and activists, with police support, to open fire on unarmed protesters on August 5, 2024.
The six victims identified by the prosecution are Ashraful Islam, Suruj Ali Babu, Abdullah Al Mustakin, Osama, Bablu Farazi, and Yusuf Sheikh.
All four convicted leaders are currently absconding.
